detail: Every number is taken while the body hangs in a 9.5 degree head-up tilt suspension (nearly horizontal, about 17% of Earth's gravity along the body axis) that the model has no input for; the paper itself notes that body posture changes VO2peak (up to ~20% lower supine) and that exercise intensity was set relative to upright cycling. The load could be written as a measured VO2 on the activity input, but the README says a posture change is an input to refuse, not to approximate with something else. The paper's only other markers are resting heart rate, blood pressure and lactate (Tables 1 and 6), with no stated posture, setting, clock time or fed state, so none could be entered without a meal or a run-in the paper does not give.
